name: Nex War
summary: Nex War is a free action MMORPG played in the web browser, on PC and mobile, built around skillshot combat: every spell, arrow and blade swing is aimed by hand at the reticle, with nothing that locks on or auto-targets. There are no classes and no character levels; players mix active and passive spells from nine schools of magic and weapons, and every piece of gear is gathered, refined and crafted by players. The open world runs from the desert city of Aton and the forest city of Zugmar out through tiered zones to the Breach at the heart of the world: the first tier is safe from other players, further out PvP is open and a defeated player's bag drops, and the deepest zones are full loot. Guilds besiege forts and player cities, and a ranked arena runs 1v1 and 2v2 ladders.
